headline: Sweethearts, Snowfall and a Sneak Peek at 2027
tagline: The holidays are in full swing, candy canes are about to drop, and Disneyland just revealed its 2027 After Dark lineup.

lead.title: Disneyland After Dark 2027 Lineup Revealed, With a Brand-New Nite
lead.body: Separately ticketed After Dark nights kick off with Sweethearts' Nite in late January, and a new Disneylandia Nite celebrating Hispanic and Latin cultures is set for April 11, 13 and 15. Star Wars Nite (Apr 27, 29; May 4, 6) and Pride Nite (Jun 17) round out the list. Ticket on-sale dates haven't been announced.

events.title: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: Festive décor, seasonal food, and a Santa spot at Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn. "it's a small world" Holiday glows with 400,000 lights.

events.title: Disney Festival of Holidays
events.body: Six festive marketplaces with new and returning bites, plus ¡Viva Navidad! on Buena Vista Street.

events.title: Downtown Disney Nightly Snowfall
events.dates: Nightly through Jan 6, 2027 (start date varies by source)
events.body: Snow flurries fall on the lawn near the LIVE! Stage in the evenings. One outlet says the transformation began Nov 23, others say Nov 13, so check the schedule.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: Buy an activity map at a participating Downtown Disney shop, find the hidden ornaments and trade the map for a keepsake. Per fan-site reports; confirm details on site.

events.title: Handmade Candy Canes
events.body: Candy Palace and Trolley Treats pull handmade candy canes on these days. They sell out early, so arrive at park opening for a wristband.

events.title: Santa Meet-and-Greets
events.body: Santa greets guests at Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn in Disneyland and at Redwood Creek Challenge Trail in Disney California Adventure.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition of World of Color lights up Paradise Bay with scenes from Beauty and the Beast and Inside Out.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the Haunted Mansion runs into the new year.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Monsters, Inc. Mike & Sulley to the Rescue!
events.body: The Monstropolis dark ride is staying open longer than planned. No specific closing date has been announced.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa at Naples
events.body: A Downtown Disney breakfast with Santa. Reservations are open through Patina Group.

events.title: Sweethearts' Nite
events.body: The first After Dark night of 2027 is a separately ticketed evening in Disneyland park. One source also lists Feb 16; ticket details TBA.

events.title: Disneylandia Nite
events.body: A new After Dark event celebrating Hispanic and Latin cultures. Sales details are expected in early 2027.

events.title: Lunar New Year 2027
events.body: No official dates yet. The 2026 festival ran Jan 23 – Feb 22 at Disney California Adventure.

events.title: Remember… Dreams Come True Returns
events.body: A refreshed version of the Disneyland fireworks spectacular is slated to return. Nightly schedules haven't been announced.

events.title: World of Color (Original) Returns
events.body: An updated version of the original World of Color is slated to return to Paradise Bay.

tip: Candy cane wristbands go fast: arrive at park opening on Nov 27 (Disneyland) or Nov 28 (DCA).
caveats: Dates come from Disney press coverage and fan sites as of Nov 26, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
